description_en: Queries the 95th percentile traffic data of an Internet Shared Bandwidth instance that uses the enhanced 95th percentile billing method
description_zh: 调用Describe95Traffic接口查询按增强型95计费共享带宽的95流量数据
kebab_example: aliyun vpc describe-95-traffic --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type cbwp --instance-id cbwp-wz9j19xrwf78fvz700000 --day 2022-10-22 --region cn-hangzhou
name: Describe95Traffic

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the resource.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
资源所属的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The resource type. Only cbwp is supported, which indicates Internet Shared Bandwidth
parameters.help_zh: 资源类型，仅支持cbwp，表示共享带宽
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en:
The date to query, in UTC+8. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

Only data from the previous month or earlier can be queried
parameters.help_zh:
指定待查询日期，使用北京时间，格式：年-月-日。

仅支持查询上月及之前的数据
parameters.name: day

Traffic95Summary.description_en: The bandwidth statistics information of the Internet Shared Bandwidth instance that uses the enhanced 95th percentile billing method
Traffic95Summary.description_zh: 增强型95计费共享带宽的带宽统计信息

Bandwidth.description_en: The peak bandwidth of the Internet Shared Bandwidth instance on the queried date. Unit: Mbit/s
Bandwidth.description_zh: 共享带宽实例在所查询时间当天的峰值带宽。单位：Mbps

FifthPeakBandwidth.description_en:
The daily peak bandwidth. Unit: Mbit/s.

<props="china">For more information, see [Daily peak bandwidth]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/89729.html）.</props>
FifthPeakBandwidth.description_zh:
日峰值带宽，单位为Mbps。

<props="china">更多信息，请参见[日峰值带宽]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/89729.html）。</props>

InternetChargeType.description_en:
The billable methods of the Internet Shared Bandwidth instance on the queried date. Valid values:
PayBy95: enhanced 95th percentile billing.
PayByBandwidth: pay-by-bandwidth.
PayByDominantTraffic: pay-by-dominant-traffic
InternetChargeType.description_zh:
共享带宽实例在所查询时间当天的计费方式。取值
PayBy95：按增强型 95 计费。
PayByBandwidth：按带宽计费。
PayByDominantTraffic：按主流量计费

MinimumConsumeBandwidth.description_en: The minimum guaranteed bandwidth of the Internet Shared Bandwidth instance on the queried date. Unit: Mbit/s
MinimumConsumeBandwidth.description_zh: 共享带宽实例在所查询时间当天的保底带宽。单位：Mbps

Traffic95Detail.description_en: The list of average bandwidth values sampled every 5 minutes for inbound and outbound traffic on the queried date
Traffic95Detail.description_zh: 入方向和出方向当天每5分钟内的带宽平均值列表

items.description_en: The average bandwidth values for inbound and outbound traffic sampled at 5-minute intervals on the queried date
items.description_zh: 以5分钟为粒度采样，入方向和出方向在所查询日期每5分钟内的带宽平均值

BillBandwidth.description_en: The bandwidth value at the sampling point, which is the larger value between inbound and outbound bandwidth during the time interval. Unit: Mbit/s
BillBandwidth.description_zh: 采样点带宽值，为该时间区间内入方向和出方向中较大的带宽。单位：Mbps
